text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(My limbs feel heavy... my heart is still pounding painfully.
Even so... I'm okay.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I need to get to where Trainer is...!)
—I was overwhelmed. Even among older competitors, she glided past with ease. Stunned by her earnest, straightforward stride...
I was given courage... and confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Um...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Thank you for giving me courage.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I'm so glad.
I'm so glad that you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we could meet "right now"...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What happened after the Hanshin JF...
Do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll tell you all about it
once the Oka Sho is over!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...There was something I couldn't help wondering about.
'Why did it have to be "now"?'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"‘If only I had reached my peak after growing up a bit more...
Then I could proudly encourage Trainer.’
...is what she said."

"If only I had met her once I was more capable as a Trainer..."
I, too, had once harbored similar thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone tells me how amazing it is to skip a grade.
But... it's also true that there are many disadvantages
and tough challenges compared to the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm certain
it had to be "now," or it wouldn't have worked.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...It's "Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because I skipped a grade to enroll here... I was able to meet
such a hardworking, kind Trainer who worries a lot
and takes everything to heart.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even though it must be so tough for you,
you keep running all over the place just for me...
You're so, so kind, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because you're that kind of Trainer,
I... feel like I want to try even harder.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That is why I believe my growth spurt came earlier
than it did for other girls.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In order to meet
my Trainer today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why... the cheers I received
from everyone today belong to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's proof that you're a wonderful Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
You are a truly wonderful Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because you brought little old me
all the way here!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll work
even harder and harder!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for putting your heart into it.
I felt every bit of it!

She was always like that.
Even in a once-in-a-lifetime race,
she ran for my sake.
choice_data_list: Could it be, even challenging a GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I thought maybe if I won a big race, I could be of some help to Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone realized what a
wonderful Trainer you truly are♪

Simply put, it was purely good fortune that let me become her Trainer.
Why does she place so much trust in someone like me...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...?
What do you mean, 'why'?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Working so hard for me,
treasuring me, and believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Is it weird... to want to do my best
for the kind person who always stays by my side?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to thank me!
I'm just doing this because I want to.
choice_data_list: Thank you for meeting me in the "now"!

text_block_list.text: Her kindness was deeper than I could have ever imagined. While feeling grateful, I acutely realize my own inadequacy.
choice_data_list: (I want to be a Trainer who can support her.)

text_block_list.text:
"I will grow even further as a Trainer."
My resolve only grew stronger—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I want to keep pushing forward just like this.
Push forward—now that the Oka Sho is over, that means taking on the second leg of the Triple Tiara: the Yushun Himba (Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like I can run forever. That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
All right.
I'll go change now!

...Watching Nishino Flower's back as she leaves,
I ponder. A faint ember of anxiety lingers within me.

Middle distance, a distance she had never targeted before.
Whether this distance allows her to demonstrate her true potential...

Even so, if she's looking toward the future,
then all I can do is charge forward together with her.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Gerbera-san, you bloomed so beautifully♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best from now on,
so that lots of friends can bloom...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I'll do my best in the Oaks too!"
